news.title: Nikita Kucherov scores power-play goal in overtime and Lightning rally for 4-3 win over Wild
news.ruTitle: Никита Кучеров забил гол в большинстве в овертайме и в розыгрыше «Лайтнинг» одержал победу над «Уайлдом» со счетом 4:3.
news.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored a power-play goal 3:23 into overtime and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied past the Minnesota Wild 4-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Harley has a goal and 2 assists to lead the Stars past the struggling Sharks, 4-3
news.ruTitle: Харли забил гол и сделал 2 результативные передачи, чтобы вывести "Старз" из борьбы с "Шаркс" со счетом 4-3.
news.description: — Defenseman Thomas Harley scored one of Dallas’ three power-play goals in his first three-point game of the season and the Stars beat the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Martinook, Svechnikov score twice as Hurricanes top Blackhawks 9-2
news.ruTitle: Мартинук и Свечников забили два гола, а «Харрикейнз» обыграли «Блэкхокс» со счетом 9–2.
news.description: — Jordan Martinook scored two of Carolina’s four first-period goals in the Hurricanes’ 9-2 win over the Chicago Blackhawks on Saturday night.

news.title: Cousins breaks tie with 2:18 left in the Senators' 4-2 victory over the Mammoth
news.ruTitle: Казинс разрывает ничью за 2:18 до конца победы сенаторов над Мамонтом со счетом 4:2.
news.description: — Nick Cousins broke a tie on a deflection with 2:18 left and the Ottawa Senators beat the Utah Mammoth 4-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as Devils rally past Islanders 5-4
news.ruTitle: Джек Хьюз забивает в овертайме, когда "Девилз" обыграли "Айлендерс" со счетом 5:4
news.description: — Jack Hughes scored in overtime to lift the New Jersey Devils to a 5-4 victory over the New York Islanders on Saturday.

news.title: Newhook scores twice in the Canadiens’ 4-2 win over the Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Ньюхук забивает дважды в победном матче «Канадиенс» над «Мэйпл Лифс» со счётом 4:2.
news.description: — Alex Newhook scored twice in the first period, Jacob Fowler made 26 saves and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Rangers hold off the Kraken 4-3 for their 3rd straight victory
news.ruTitle: Рейнджерс обыграли Кракена со счетом 4-3 и одержали третью победу подряд
news.description: — Gabe Perreault, Tye Kartye and Jaroslav Chmelar scored in the first period and the New York Rangers held off the Seattle Kraken 4-3 on Saturday for their third straight victory.

news.title: Who has scored the most goals in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Кто забил больше всего голов в истории НХЛ?
news.description: Alex Ovechkin holds the record for the most individual career goals in NHL history. Which other players are at the top of the list?

news.title: Stamkos has goal, assist to lead Predators to 3-1 victory over Blues
news.ruTitle: Стэмкос забил гол и сделал результативную передачу, чтобы «Хищники» одержали победу над «Блюзом» со счетом 3:1.
news.description: — Steven Stamkos had a goal and an assist and Juuse Saros made 25 saves to lead the Nashville Predators to a 3-1 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday.

news.title: Capitals rally for a 4-3 win over Florida despite Wilson's ejection for a hit on Vilmanis
news.ruTitle: «Кэпиталз» одержали победу над «Флоридой» со счетом 4:3, несмотря на удаление Уилсона из-за удара по Вилманису.
news.description: — Alex Tuch and Aliaksei Protas scored in the second period to lift the Washington Capitals to a 4-3 victory over the Florida Panthers on Saturday.

news.title: Panthers' Sandis Vilmanis exits game after hit by Capitals' Tom Wilson
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Пантерс» Сандис Вилманис выбыл из игры после удара игрока «Кэпиталз» Тома Уилсона
news.description: Panthers forward Sandis Vilmanis was shaken up after a hit by Washington's Tom Wilson, who was given a major penalty for boarding and a game misconduct.
